name: Takizawa Masayuki
source:
A diligent young man who works as a gardener for the Kirishima family. In addition to gardening and shopping, he is entrusted with physically demanding tasks that are difficult for Yoriko. 
Like Yoriko, he is unaware that the reason Mimasaka and the others are staying at the villa is the "game."

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/PigeonBlood]Wikipedia[/url]]
